en: The BukSU enrollment process for undergraduate, graduate, law, and medicine applicants has four main steps.

Step 1: Submit your documentary requirements to the University Registrar's Office. First year and transferee applicants must prepare the required long brown envelopes and submit the needed original documents and photocopies.
Step 2: Log in to https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph and apply for enrollment. Online Enrollment Application opens on July 1, 2026.
Step 3: Wait for the evaluator's approval from July 1 to 31, 2026. Once approved, download your Certificate of Registration (COR) through the admissions portal.
Step 4: Validate your enrollment from July 1 to August 31, 2026. Paying students must complete payment first, while non-paying students still need account verification and enrollment validation.
ceb: Ang BukSU enrollment process para sa undergraduate, graduate, law, ug medicine applicants adunay upat ka main steps.

Step 1: I-submit ang documentary requirements sa University Registrar's Office. Ang first year ug transferee applicants kinahanglan mag-andam sa required long brown envelopes ug ipasa ang original documents ug photocopies.
Step 2: Pag-log in sa https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph ug pag-apply for enrollment. Ang Online Enrollment Application mag-open sa July 1, 2026.
Step 3: Hulata ang approval sa evaluator gikan July 1 hangtod July 31, 2026. Kung approved na, i-download ang imong Certificate of Registration (COR) sa admissions portal.

Step 4: I-validate ang imong enrollment gikan July 1 hangtod August 31, 2026. Ang paying students kinahanglan magbayad una, samtang ang non-paying students kinahanglan gihapon moagi sa account verification ug enrollment validation.

en: There is no exact fixed enrollment time or day because Bukidnon State University may adjust the enrollment schedule every academic year.

Kasagaran, ang enrollment announcements ipahibalo around June or July, pero mas maayo nga hulaton gyud ang opisyal nga schedule gikan sa University Registrar.
Para sa opisyal nga updates, i-follow ang BukSU Registrar page: https://www.facebook.com/BSURegistrar

en: For undergraduate first year and transferee enrollment, Step 1 is the submission of documentary requirements to the University Registrar's Office until July 16, 2026.
Prepare 2 long brown envelopes: Envelope 1 is the Registrar's Copy and Envelope 2 is the Student's Copy.

Envelope 1 should contain original documents unless stated otherwise: Program Acceptance Slip, Report Card, Good Moral, Honorable Dismissal for transferees only, Transcript of Records for transferees only, Subject Equivalency Form for transferees, photocopy of PSA Birth Certificate, photocopy of Marriage Contract if married, BukSU-CAT Report of Rating, and photocopy of Medical Certificate.

Envelope 2 should contain photocopies of the same requirements: Program Acceptance Slip, Report Card, Good Moral, Honorable Dismissal for transferees only, Transcript of Records for transferees only, Subject Equivalency Form for transferees, PSA Birth Certificate, Marriage Contract if married, BukSU-CAT Report of Rating, and Medical Certificate.

You also need to submit to your department or program an original Medical Certificate issued by a Government Physician stating that you are physically fit for off-campus and in-campus activities, and an original Notarized General Parental or Guardian Consent Form.
Download the consent form here: https://buksu.edu.ph/downloadable-forms/
ceb: Para sa undergraduate first year ug transferee enrollment, ang Step 1 mao ang pag-submit sa documentary requirements sa University Registrar's Office hangtod July 16, 2026.

Ang Envelope 1 kinahanglan adunay original documents gawas kung stated otherwise: Program Acceptance Slip, Report Card, Good Moral, Honorable Dismissal para sa transferees only, Transcript of Records para sa transferees only, Subject Equivalency Form para sa transferees, photocopy sa PSA Birth Certificate, photocopy sa Marriage Contract kung minyo, BukSU-CAT Report of Rating, ug photocopy sa Medical Certificate.

Ang Envelope 2 kinahanglan adunay photocopies sa parehas nga requirements: Program Acceptance Slip, Report Card, Good Moral, Honorable Dismissal para sa transferees only, Transcript of Records para sa transferees only, Subject Equivalency Form para sa transferees, PSA Birth Certificate, Marriage Contract kung minyo, BukSU-CAT Report of Rating, ug Medical Certificate.

Kinahanglan usab nimo i-submit sa imong department o program ang original Medical Certificate gikan sa Government Physician nga nag-ingon nga physically fit ka for off-campus and in-campus activities, ug original Notarized General Parental or Guardian Consent Form.
I-download ang consent form diri: https://buksu.edu.ph/downloadable-forms/

en: Step 2 of the enrollment process is the Online Enrollment Application through https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph.
The Online Enrollment Application will be open on July 1, 2026.
After logging in, click Admission.
Click Show Exam Result, then proceed to Enrollment.
Click Apply Enrollment.
Under Campus Selection, select Main Campus.
Under Course Selection, select your preferred course.

Under Documentary Requirements, scan and upload the documentary requirements specified in Step 1. Documents uploaded during admission must be duly marked with a RECEIVED stamp by the University Registrar's Office.
Under Learning Modality Preference, select your preferred learning modality.
Under Academic Information, fill in the necessary information.
ceb: Ang Step 2 sa enrollment process mao ang Online Enrollment Application pinaagi sa https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph.
Ang Online Enrollment Application mag-open sa July 1, 2026.
Pagkahuman og log in, i-click ang Admission.
I-click ang Show Exam Result, dayon proceed sa Enrollment.
I-click ang Apply Enrollment.
Sa Campus Selection, pili-a ang Main Campus.
Sa Course Selection, pili-a ang imong preferred course.

Sa Documentary Requirements, i-scan ug i-upload ang documentary requirements nga naa sa Step 1. Ang documents nga gi-upload during admission kinahanglan duly marked with RECEIVED stamp sa University Registrar's Office.
Sa Learning Modality Preference, pili-a ang imong preferred learning modality.
Sa Academic Information, pun-a ang necessary information.

en: Step 4 is Validation of Enrollment from July 1 to August 31, 2026.

For on-site payment: print your Certificate of Registration (COR), then proceed to the Accounting Office, Windows 3 to 5, for account verification. This applies to both paying and non-paying students.
For paying students, pay at the Cashier's Office Window 10.
After account verification or payment, proceed to the University Registrar's Office for enrollment validation. This applies to both paying and non-paying students.
For online payment: access your COR through https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph to determine the required down payment for official enrollment.
Go to https://www.lbp-eservices.com/egps/portal/index.jsp, click Pay Now, search and select Merchant Name: Bukidnon State University, then click Continue.

Select the transaction type Tuition and Other School Fees, then click Continue. Fill out the transaction details, choose your preferred payment mode, input the captcha, agree to the Terms and Conditions, and submit the payment details including OTP and ATM PIN if required.
You can view your enrollment status through SIAS Online 10 working days after payment.
ceb: Ang Step 4 mao ang Validation of Enrollment gikan July 1 hangtod August 31, 2026.

Para sa on-site payment: i-print ang imong Certificate of Registration (COR), dayon adto sa Accounting Office, Windows 3 to 5, para sa account verification. Applicable kini sa paying ug non-paying students.
Para sa paying students, pagbayad sa Cashier's Office Window 10.
Human sa account verification o payment, adto sa University Registrar's Office para sa enrollment validation. Applicable kini sa paying ug non-paying students.
Para sa online payment: access imong COR sa https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph aron makita ang required down payment para sa official enrollment.
Adto sa https://www.lbp-eservices.com/egps/portal/index.jsp, i-click ang Pay Now, pangitaa ug pili-a ang Merchant Name: Bukidnon State University, dayon click Continue.

Pili-a ang transaction type nga Tuition and Other School Fees, dayon click Continue. Pun-a ang transaction details, pili-a ang preferred payment mode, input captcha, agree sa Terms and Conditions, ug i-submit ang payment details apil ang OTP ug ATM PIN kung required.
Makita nimo ang enrollment status sa SIAS Online 10 working days after payment.

en: For incoming First Year Nursing students, especially waitlisted applicants who became eligible to enroll, please go directly to the College of Nursing (CON).
CON can release your acceptance slip and other forms, and they will also give the official instructions on what to do next.

For medical requirements, follow the checklist or forms given by CON. If a medical laboratory examination is needed, you may look for a medical laboratory nearby or any laboratory accepted by the college instruction.
If you do not have an immunization or vaccine record, go to your barangay health center or the health center where you were immunized and request a certificate or record of your immunization.
For the process of submitting requirements, follow the instruction given by CON after you receive your acceptance slip and forms.
ceb: Para sa incoming First Year Nursing students, labi na sa waitlisted applicants nga nahimong eligible to enroll, adto diretso sa College of Nursing (CON).
Ang CON ang mohatag sa imong acceptance slip ug uban pang forms, ug sila pud ang mohatag sa official instructions kung unsay sunod buhaton.

Para sa medical requirements, sundon ang checklist o forms nga ihatag sa CON. Kung kinahanglan og medical laboratory examination, pangita og medical laboratory nearby o laboratory nga dawaton base sa instruction sa college.
Kung wala kay immunization o vaccine record, adto sa inyong barangay health center o sa health center kung asa ka na-immunize ug pangayo og certificate o record sa imong immunization.
Para sa process sa pagpasa sa requirements, sundon ang instruction nga ihatag sa CON human nimo madawat ang acceptance slip ug forms.

en: Students are required to pay for laboratory, ID, and miscellaneous fees. Tuition is free at Bukidnon State University depending on the program you are enrolled in.

However, some courses may have additional charges for laboratory equipment and required textbooks. Your college department may provide some instructions on how you pay for these fees, so it is recommended to check with them for more details.
But you can also ask the accounting office, on the Finance building since they can give you more information about the fees and payment process.
ceb: Mga estudyante kinahanglan magbayad para sa laboratory, ID, ug miscellaneous fees. Libre ang tuition sa Bukidnon State University depende sa programa nga imong gi-enrollan.

Apan, ang uban nga mga kurso posibleng adunay dugang nga bayad para sa laboratory equipment ug required textbooks. Ang imong college department posibleng maghatag og mga instruksyon kung unsaon pagbayad sa mga fees, mao nga girekomenda nga mag-check ka sa ila para sa mas klaro nga detalye.
Pero pwede pud nimo adtuhon ang accounting office, sa Finance building kay sila makahatag og dugang impormasyon bahin sa mga fees ug proseso sa pagbayad.

en: A paying student is a student who needs to pay the assessed tuition and/or other school fees for the enrollment period.
This can happen if the student is not eligible for Free Higher Education, voluntarily opts out of the free higher education benefit, or has charges that are assessed separately by the university.

For program-specific assessment, especially if you see payment instructions in your COR, verify directly with the Accounting Office, Registrar, or your college because the chatbot should not assume your final payment status.
ceb: Ang paying student mao ang estudyante nga kinahanglan mobayad sa assessed tuition ug/o other school fees para sa enrollment period.
Mahitabo kini kung ang estudyante dili eligible sa Free Higher Education, voluntarily mo-opt out sa free higher education benefit, o adunay charges nga separately gi-assess sa university.

Para sa program-specific assessment, labi na kung naa kay payment instructions sa imong COR, mas maayo nga mo-verify diretso sa Accounting Office, Registrar, o imong college kay dili dapat mag-assume ang chatbot sa final payment status nimo.

en: A non-paying student is a student whose tuition and covered school fees are under the Free Higher Education benefit.
This usually means the student is eligible for free tuition and covered school fees and did not opt out of the benefit.

Even if a student is non-paying, they may still need to complete account verification and enrollment validation, and there may be personal or program-related expenses such as uniforms, books, supplies, or other requirements.
ceb: Ang non-paying student mao ang estudyante nga ang tuition ug covered school fees naa ilalom sa Free Higher Education benefit.
Kasagaran pasabot ani kay eligible ang estudyante sa free tuition ug covered school fees ug wala siya nag-opt out sa benefit.

Bisan non-paying student, kinahanglan gihapon moagi sa account verification ug enrollment validation, ug posible gihapon adunay personal o program-related expenses sama sa uniforms, books, supplies, o uban pang requirements.

phrases: what does non paying student mean

en: Paying students and non-paying students are different based on how their tuition and school fees are assessed during enrollment.

Paying student: a student who needs to pay assessed tuition and/or other school fees. This may happen if the student is not eligible for Free Higher Education, voluntarily opts out, or has assessed charges that are not covered by the benefit.
Non-paying student: a student whose tuition and covered school fees are under the Free Higher Education benefit.
Important: Do not assume that a specific course is automatically paying or non-paying. For final payment status, check the COR and verify with Accounting, Registrar, or your college.
ceb: Ang paying students ug non-paying students lahi base sa pag-assess sa ilang tuition ug school fees during enrollment.

Paying student: estudyante nga kinahanglan mobayad sa assessed tuition ug/o other school fees. Mahitabo kini kung dili siya eligible sa Free Higher Education, voluntarily ni-opt out, o adunay assessed charges nga dili covered sa benefit.
Non-paying student: estudyante nga ang tuition ug covered school fees naa ilalom sa Free Higher Education benefit.
Important: Ayaw i-assume nga ang specific course automatic paying o non-paying. Para sa final payment status, tan-awa ang COR ug pangutana sa Accounting, Registrar, o imong college.

en: Transferees from public schools may enroll, subject to the evaluation of their academic records.
However, students transferring from private schools should expect possible delays in the process.
Please note that for private school transferees, previously taken subjects may not be credited.
As a result, you may be required to retake courses as a first-year student.
ceb: Ang mga transferees gikan sa public schools mahimong maka-enroll basta ma-evaluate ang ilang academic records.
Apan ang mga estudyante nga mobalhin gikan sa private schools kinahanglan mag-expect og posibleng delay sa proseso.
Palihog timan-i nga para sa mga transferees gikan sa private schools, posibleng dili ma-credit ang ilang mga previous subjects.
Tungod niini, mahimong kinahanglan nimo kuhaon balik ang mga subject sama sa usa ka first-year student.

en: No double enrollment is not allowed. A student must first officially withdraw or secure an Honorable Dismissal from the current school before enrolling in BukSU.
